ValidationRule.description: Stop Activity Due Date for Account Review from being updated after Status of the Activity is Completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT( $User.ProfileId = '00e90000001wK8z'), /*SysAdmins*/ ISPICKVAL ( Subtype__c , "Account Review"), ISPICKVAL ( Status , "Completed"), ISCHANGED ( ActivityDate ), LEFT(WhatId, 3) = '001' /*Account RelatedTo only*/ )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allow to change the Due Date once the Account Review is Completed. Please contact SHR Salesforce Support for more information.
